references.text: Mentions Terah (Θάρα) as the father of Abram (Ἀβραὰμ), Nahor (Ναχὼρ), and Haran.
Refers to the family of Terah (Θάρα), including Abram (Ἀβραὰμ), Nahor (Ναχὼρ), and their relationships.
God calls Abram (Ἀβραὰμ), son of Terah (Θάρα), to leave his home.
The birth of Isaac (Ἰσαὰκ), son of Abraham (Ἀβραὰμ).
The birth of Jacob (Ἰακὼβ) and Esau, sons of Isaac (Ἰσαὰκ).
